title: AROH Payment & Financial Data Processing Register
effective_framework: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 & DPDP Rules, 2025

entries.source: Self-attestation or age-band assurance provider during purchase checkout
entries.purpose: Enforce strict 18+ adult age eligibility policy, block minor payment initiation, and prevent unauthorized transactions on third-party instruments
entries.legal_basis: Consent (DPDP Act Sec 6), Child Protection (Sec 9), and Legitimate Uses (Sec 7)
entries.storage_system: Firestore Collection: purchase_eligibility / In-Memory Mock Store in dev
entries.retention_period: Duration of active user account plus 30 days post-account closure
entries.deletion_method: Hard programmatic purge upon account deletion request
entries.logging: Status evaluations logged in security audit trail; raw government IDs never collected or logged
entries.sharing: None with third parties outside verification provider if configured

entries.source: Data Principal affirmative confirmation on purchase checkout
entries.purpose: Record unbundled, explicit, affirmative consent for Aros token purchase, 18+ attestation, and non-monetary utility acknowledgement
entries.storage_system: Firestore Collection: purchase_consents / In-Memory Mock Store in dev
entries.retention_period: 3 years post-account closure for compliance audit trail
entries.logging: Consent events logged with SHA-256 hash references; zero raw card/bank data logged

entries.source: Generated server-side upon verified eligibility and consent
entries.purpose: Orchestrate payment provider session creation, maintain idempotency, and reconcile payment settlement
entries.legal_basis: Contractual necessity (Indian Contract Act 1872) and Legitimate Uses (Sec 7 DPDP Act)
entries.processor: Stripe Inc. / Decoupled Payment Provider Adapter
entries.storage_system: Payment Gateway Tokenized Infrastructure & AROH Payment Database
entries.retention_period: 7 years from transaction date for statutory financial auditing
entries.logging: Zero card numbers, zero CVV, zero UPI MPIN, zero bank credentials stored or logged by AROH
entries.sharing: Payment gateway processor for transaction authorization
entries.international_transfer: Applicable for global payment gateways subject to standard contractual clauses

entries.purpose: Maintain tamper-evident, append-only ledger of all Aros token credits, debits, refunds, and adjustments
entries.legal_basis: Contractual necessity, fraud prevention, and commercial dispute resolution
entries.storage_system: Firestore Collection: transactions / in-memory store in dev
entries.deletion_method: Cryptographic decoupling and pseudonymization (user ID hashed with irreversible salt)

entries.collection_point: Purchase completion notification & user receipt center
entries.purpose: Provide Data Principal with permanent proof of transaction, consumer disclosure, and dispute routing
entries.legal_basis: Contractual obligation and Consumer Protection Act, 2019
entries.storage_system: Firestore Collection: receipts / in-memory store in dev
